translation:
For the strangury (lin) condition, the former sages set up five names: blood, qi, paste, sand and fatigue make them up. Qi-strangury: defecation difficult, dripping with leftover; blood-strangury: blood in the urine, pain hard to stretch out.
Paste-strangury: weak (urine) flowing like paste and grease-fat; sand-strangury: essential (qi) congealing into the form of sand and stone. Fatigue-strangury: sexual exertion making it erupt with pain; there is also blood-in-urine without pain — genuine.
In all these, interior injury of the seven emotions cause them; exterior contraction of the six vapors, old like new. If you seek the efficacious elixir, or early illness, Wulin Sanzi (Five-Strangury Powder) may be pursued.
Inside Wulin San (Five-Strangury Powder) are Chifuling (red Poria); Mutong (Akebia), Gancao (Licorice), Dang Gui and Huangqin (Scutellaria). Zhizi (Gardenia), Huashi (Talc) and Chishao (Red Peony); let you add and subtract to treat the various stranguries.
translator_notes: 五淋=the five stranguries (blood, qi, paste/creamy, sand/stony, fatigue/labor).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
Why does the urine come to be obstructed? The heart channel's heat-pathogen lodges in profusion. Metal (lung) can engender water; in the upper source it governs. When it meets with overcoming, it is hard for the qi to be the transforming master.
It is like a water-storing vessel of the study chamber; the upper orifice open, then the lower is blocked. There is also difficult urination and short urination; difficulty (nan) is difficulty, shortness (duan) is lacking in length.
There is again the turned-bladder (zhuanbao) and closed-block (longbi) conditions; the public errand (pregnancy) of the wedded woman goes as usual. The method of treatment: raise and lift, do not let seep down; beyond this Tongguan (Open-the-Pass) with additions and subtractions, good.
Why does the stool not pass? The lung department, from the origin, lacks transformation and generation; thereby the middle province loses its conveyance and delivery; the chaff (residue) and food-stasis with fire contend with each other.
Pitiable, the kidney's body fluids exhausted; the yangming increasingly bound (constipated), with no stool-mound to mount. The aged have little blood and much bound accumulation; Runchang Tang Yin (Moisten-the-Intestine Beverage), subtract and increase.
If both the large and small urination be closed, yin and yang both bound, heat-wind engenders; Daohuan Qilang (Reverse-the-Change Dung-Beetle) unblocks the viscera and bowels, no clear water and fire, down gushes like a landslide.

Runchang Wan (Moisten-the-Intestine Pill)
Dang Gui, Shengdi (Rehmannia), Shudi (prepared Rehmannia), Huoma (Huomaren/Hemp Seed), Tao (Taoren/Peach Kernel), Xing (Xingren/Apricot Kernel), Ling (Fuling/Poria), Ke (Zhike/Bitter Orange), Pu (Houpu), Huang (Dahuang/Rhubarb), Cao (Gancao/Licorice).

Runchang Wan treats difficult stool; with Xiao (Mirabilitum) and Huang (Dahuang) and raw honey, how cold its nature! Shengdi, Dang Gui, Binglang and Zhi (Zhike).

Daohuan Qilang Dan (Reverse-the-Change Dung-Beetle Elixir)
Jing-ai (Schizonepeta), Dahuang (Rhubarb), Qilang (Dung-Beetle/Catharsius)
translator_notes: 轉胞=reversed/turned bladder (urinary retention esp. in pregnancy); 窿閉=longbì (urinary block).
潤腸丸=Runchang Wan; 倒換蜣螂丹=Daohuan Qilang Dan.
unresolved: "公差朵婦" obscure — possibly pregnant woman's bladder disorder.
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）

translation:
The block-and-strangury (guan-ge) condition is often one of peril and death; above, vomiting water; below, closed, destroying its primordial. Cold in the upper, with nothing entering the interior — this is the block (guan) condition, water hard to transmit.
Heat in the lower jiao, hard to exit and enter — it is named the strangury (ge) condition, no door in the four openings. Ge (strangury) then vomiting reversal; guan (block) without urination; Liangzhi San-Chen Tang (Two-Zhi Three-Matured Decoction) is no hindrance.
Liangzhi San-Chen (Two-Zhi Three-Matured) treats block-and-strangury; Erchen (Two-Matured) with Zhishi (Immature Bitter Orange), Zhiqiao (Bitter Orange shell) and Nanxing (Arisaema); above and below purified and cleared, unblocking the exterior and interior — then one knows in one stroke the drumbeat of accomplished merit.
translator_notes: 關格=guān gé (block and outflow reversal).
兩枳三陳湯=Liangzhi San-Chen Tang (two zhi: Zhishi+Zhiqiao; three chen: Erchen constituents).
book: 七十二症辨治方法（手抄本）
